Chapter 1255: Chapter 13: Transforming into the Abyss Dragon (Requesting Monthly Tickets at the Month’s Start)_2

He didn’t know Meng Shi, there were far too many ants like Meng Shi within the Thousand Teeth Domain.

"Yes."

Dozens of pursuers looked cautiously at the Thousand Teeth King.

"No need to pursue anymore."

After pondering for a while, the Thousand Teeth King instructed, "If you encounter Meng Shi again in the future, do not take action, immediately notify me."

Although he didn’t know the purpose of the Galactic Heaven Venerable taking Meng Shi away, any involvement with the Galactic Heaven Venerable, even if it’s just an ant, the Thousand Teeth King dared not neglect.

...

Fierce Sun Capital.

Lin Yuan brought the young Meng Shi into the Galaxy Royal Mansion.

"Galaxy..."

The young Meng Shi gazed at the majestic royal mansion, vaguely guessing Lin Yuan’s true identity.

In fact, the young Meng Shi, who had come to realization, finally understood why the high and mighty Thousand Teeth King behaved that way upon seeing Lin Yuan.

Because the one who blocked him was the Galaxy Venerate.

The Galaxy Venerate, who shook the Six Great Ancient Kingdoms.

The Martial Arts Inheritance the young Meng Shi attempted to cultivate not long ago was created by the Galaxy Venerate.

Very soon.

The young Meng Shi, feeling anxious, reached the depths of the royal mansion.

"You should know who I am by now, right?"

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, smiling as he looked at the young Meng Shi.

"I greet the Galaxy Venerate."

The young Meng Shi kneeled down with a thud.

In terms of gratitude, if it wasn’t for the Galaxy Venerate, he would likely have been captured by the subordinates of the Thousand Teeth King.

In terms of strength, the Galaxy Venerate is known as the strongest under the Ancestors of the Six Great Ancient Kingdoms.

The young Meng Shi naturally understood who he was facing now.

"Stand up."

With a wave of Lin Yuan’s hand, the young Meng Shi felt an invisible force lifting him up.

"I intend to take you as my disciple, would you be willing?"

Lin Yuan said with a smile.

The young Meng Shi’s Martial Tao talent concerning time was too rare; without Lin Yuan’s guidance, it would be easy for him to take a wrong path and waste this talent.

"I am willing, I, Meng Shi, am willing."

The young Meng Shi prostrated himself abruptly: "Greetings, Master."

"Hmm."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Subsequently, Lin Yuan provided some brief advice on Meng Shi’s martial cultivation.

"Your talent is excellent, just focus on the aspect of time, strive to coalesce the Time Primordial Spirit."

Lin Yuan instructed.

...

Golden Mist Treasure Land.

Lin Yuan continuously sent out some avatars, accepting some seedlings with decent Martial Talent from within the scope of the Six Great Ancient Kingdoms to personally cultivate them.

These seedlings would be the pillars of the branches on the Martial Arts Evolution Road in the future, as well as the foundation for Lin Yuan after establishing the Seventh Ancient Country.

...

"Heart of the Abyssal Dragon..."

Lin Yuan observed the heart pulsing in front of him, simultaneously splitting off an avatar to try and open up a universe on the particle level.

When Lin Yuan opened his first Particle World, it was still effortless; with his strength, opening up a world was easy, even opening within his own particles was not difficult.

However, when Lin Yuan opened his one-thousandth Particle World, he felt a slight pressure; these thousand Particle Worlds each required a portion of his mental effort, while a single Particle World occupied a negligible amount of effort, a thousand was considerable.

Especially when Lin Yuan almost devoted ninety-nine percent of his effort to comprehend the operation of the Origin Source of the Fang Yuan World.

"The one hundred twenty thousandth Particle World..."

Soon, Lin Yuan opened up the one hundred twenty thousandth Particle World; at this moment, he looked solemn with these worlds nearly occupying all his mental efforts outside comprehending the operation of the Origin Source of the Fang Yuan World.

"Not good."

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed, as a subtle imbalance emerged amongst the one hundred twenty thousand Particle Worlds, instantly causing the experimental avatar to rapidly crumble.

"Failed?"

Lin Yuan frowned tightly.

He could feel that the reason for failing to open the Particle Worlds wasn’t due to insufficient mental effort.

Even without comprehending the operation of the Origin Source of the Fang Yuan World, devoting all mental efforts to open up Particle Worlds, how many worlds could be opened up in the end?

Twelve billion?

Or one hundred twenty billion?

One should know, particles are just the most microscopic structure of life.

Compared to Lin Yuan’s true body, let alone one hundred twenty billion Particle Worlds, even ten trillion Particle Worlds are just a drop in the ocean, insignificant.

"Maintaining Particle Worlds shouldn’t consume mental effort; the existence of Particle Worlds is instinctual, just like drinking water and breathing."

Lin Yuan continued to observe the Abyss Dragon’s Heart; the first living being born in this Origin Source World, the ’Abyss Dragon,’ had each of its particles containing a vast world, and the existence of these vast worlds surely would not consume much mental effort, otherwise the Abyss Dragon would have long crumbled.

"Take your time."

Lin Yuan looked at the Abyss Dragon’s Heart, not discouraged; failing once wasn’t a big deal, through this failure, he realized that opening Particle Worlds was unrelated to mental effort, which was progress, getting him a step closer to success.

...

Deep in time and space, inside a palace.

Six Ancestors sat in succession; only the Ancestors could enter this palace in this time and space, serving as a place where the six Ancestors occasionally discussed the Tao.

However, due to Lin Yuan’s emergence, the six Ancestors had already stationed an avatar here at all times, facilitating constant communication.

In the vision of each Ancestor, numerous timelines stretched out, and if carefully observed, these timelines were all future timelines of Lin Yuan.

Upon discovering the nearly inevitable characteristics of Lin Yuan’s future, the six Ancestors naturally focused all their efforts on watching his timelines.

After all, this almost inevitable future aroused the curiosity of the six Ancestors, who wanted to know if further into the future, the timelines would continue to be such.

At the moment, Lin Yuan was still a life form at the Heavenly Venerate level; for these time life forms, viewing his timelines was still relatively easy due to the existence of a life level gap.

Once Lin Yuan also stepped into the thirteenth tier, it would be extremely difficult for the six Ancestors to view his timelines, possibly not even directly.

In such circumstances, the six Ancestors naturally tried to watch as much as they could while they still could.

After repeated attempts by the six Ancestors, they found that viewing up to Lin Yuan’s timeline three billion years into the future would cause backlash.

That backlash certainly did not only come from the timeline itself but also from the future three billion years later, where Lin Yuan would grow to a certain height, or have a profound causation with such heights of life, bringing a natural counterreaction.

"Hmm?"

At that moment, the Da Ling Ancestor’s expression changed; in the future timeline he saw, Lin Yuan had not yet entered the thirteenth tier, but he suddenly transformed into an immensely towering ’Black Dragon,’ lightly tearing open the wall membrane of the Origin Source World, arriving in the dimensional gap.

"What is this?"

The Da Ling Ancestor scrutinized Lin Yuan in that timeline, and after a moment, his expression grew somewhat incredulous.

In that timeline, the ’Black Dragon’ into which Lin Yuan transformed bore a strong resemblance to the ’Abyss Dragon’ from the dawn of creation, yet the difference in strength was as vast as heaven and earth; the aura the former emitted was nearing the thirteenth tier.

"Da Fu, look at this timeline."

The Da Ling Ancestor immediately looked toward the other five Ancestors, proactively showcasing the timeline he observed.

"The ’Black Dragon’ that the Galaxy Venerate transformed into, likely using the ’Abyss Dragon’ as a foundation, yet this power..."

The five Ancestors felt a mixture of suspicion and uncertainty; they were quite sure that at this time, Lin Yuan had not yet entered the thirteenth tier, but his strength, was it not extraordinarily formidable?

"Da Fu, when you presented that Abyss Dragon’s Heart to Galaxy, could it still harbor some secret?" Xuanyin Ancestor couldn’t help but ask.

During the meeting with the Galaxy Venerate, the Da Fu Ancestor gifted the ’Abyss Dragon’s Heart,’ and these Ancestors all witnessed it.

"What secret could there be?" Da Fu Ancestor fell into silence.

He had long comprehended the Abyss Dragon’s Heart, yet even achieving the feat of opening up worlds within all his particles could not elevate the power to such extents.

Otherwise, that ’Abyss Dragon’ wouldn’t have fallen to his Da Fu Ancestor.

What’s more, if that ’Abyss Dragon’ possessed the power of the Galaxy Venerate in this timeline, the Da Fu Ancestor would never have had the chance to step into the thirteenth tier, and would have perished at the hands of the Abyss Dragon long ago.

Yet, in this timeline, the means by which the Galaxy Venerate transformed into the Black Dragon should be derived from the Abyss Dragon.

This indicates that the Galaxy Venerate comprehended methods and secrets within the Abyss Dragon’s Heart that even he, Da Fu Ancestor, had never mastered.

"This Galaxy Venerate..."

Da Fu showed a complex expression, only finding that the Galaxy Venerate seemed more like a thirteenth-tier time life form than he himself.
